name: United States
description: Follow United States, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: The Uplift: The American Dream
changes.summary: We celebrate the United States ahead of its 250th anniversary with stories about American heroes and pastimes. The founder of e.l.f. Cosmetics shares how he made a massive life change to become a Catholic priest.

changes.title: U.S. soldier killed in Iraq, Trump orders more strikes against Iran
changes.summary: A U.S. service member was killed in Iraq on Saturday, CENTCOM announced. Separately, unidentified remains were found in Jordan at the location where a U.S. service member went missing and two others were killed following an Iranian strike. Taurean Small reports.

changes.title: The Hello Girls, America's first women soldiers, finally getting their recognition
changes.summary: Hundreds of women served in the U.S. Army Signal Corps during World War I, connecting calls for the Army in France. The women were called the "Hello Girls" and they were among America's first women soldiers. But it took decades for them to be recognized as veterans. Noel Brennan reports.

changes.title: Trump Says New Air Force One Will Be Taken Out of Service to Be ‘Maxed Out’
changes.summary: The Qatari-donated plane has been under scrutiny over whether it is fitted with sufficient defensive capabilities to adequately protect a U.S. president and others traveling on it.

changes.title: Oil Prices Cross $90 a Barrel as U.S.-Iran Conflict Widens
changes.summary: Brent crude, the global benchmark for oil, rose more than 3 percent as trading resumed on Sunday, while S&P 500 futures remained essentially unchanged.

changes.title: Rubio Says That U.S. Is Still Open to Diplomacy With Iran
changes.summary: Secretary of State Marco Rubio also said that Iran has signaled it wants to negotiate with the United States, even as the two sides escalated their attacks.

changes.title: Student loan defaults surging in wake of COVID-tied payments pause expiration
changes.summary: Defaults on student loans have surged across the United States, reaching record levels as borrowers struggle to keep up with payments.

changes.title: Morning news brief
changes.summary: The U.S. carries out a wave of strikes against Iran, as fighting between the two escalates, Congress faces long to-do list as August recess approaches, Andy Burnham becomes U.K.'s 7th prime minister.

changes.title: U.S. Service Members Killed as War Expands, and Federal Cases Against Protesters Crumble
changes.summary: Plus, what to know about the next British prime minister.

changes.title: U.S. Average Gas Price Returns to $4 a Gallon as Iran Crisis Escalates
changes.summary: A month ago, drivers were enjoying some relief at the pump after the U.S. and Iran signed a deal intended to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Now, prices are rising again.
